{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Beskar'' is a uniquely resistant iron that develops a wide range of properties&mdash;and colors&mdash;in the hands of skilled metalsmiths.|From ''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy''|<ref name="501st" />}}
'''''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy''''' was a piece of reference literature that dealt with a variety of [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Authored by [[Pilas Manaitis]] sometime prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy'' included an entry on the rare and durable [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'' iron]]. In the entry, Manaitis discussed the many different properties of ''beskar'' [[Iron/Legends|iron]], as well as the Mandalorian [[Metalsmith/Legends|metalsmiths]] who crafted the ''beskar'' iron.

==Description==
{{Quote|The ore is found solely on Mandalore, and only Mandalorians know how to work it to maximize its extraordinary properties. Therefore if you want ''beskar'', you must take Mandalore. But that inevitably proves easier to say than to do.|From ''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy''|<ref name="501st" />}}
Written by [[Pilas Manaitis]]<ref name="501st" /> sometime by [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> ''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy'' was a piece of non-fiction reference literature that focused on a number of different [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ores]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In ''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy'', Manaitis included an entry on the durable [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'' iron]], a rare ore found only on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="501st" />

In the entry, Manaitis noted that ''beskar'' had a number of different properties and [[Color/Legends|colors]], and that the [[Iron/Legends|iron]] could take a number of different forms, including plate, laminate, wire, foam, [[Mesh armor|mesh]], micronized particles, and a transparent film. The entry also mentioned the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] culture native to Mandalore and the only beings with the knowledge of how to properly craft ''beskar'' iron. Because the Mandalorian [[Metalsmith/Legends|metalsmiths]] refused to sell their ''beskar''&ndash;working skills, and because any attempt to copy the Mandalorians' ''beskar'' iron outside of Mandalore ended in failure, Manaitis stated that the only way to get ''beskar'' iron was to seize Mandalore itself, a task Manaitis considered nearly impossible given the Mandalorians' mastery of warfare.<ref name="501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Strategic Resources of the Galaxy'' was first mentioned in [[Karen Traviss]]'s [[2009]] novel ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' when the reference literature's entry on ''beskar'' iron was quoted at the start of the novel's sixth chapter.<ref name="501st" />
